name: MX3-G1-EN-WM-V5.01-20260805
body:

- Package: `rom_g1.zip`
- Build tag: `MX3-G1-EN-WM-V5.01-20260805`

## Install

1. Download `rom_g1.zip` (every numbered volume if the release has more than one, then `cat rom_g1.zip.* > rom_g1.zip`).
